author: Huawei
description:
Banks can't just layer AI onto decades-old legacy systems – they need AI-native foundations. But according to Chris Skinner, CEO of The Finanser and author of Intelligent Bank, technology alone isn't enough. In this #Huawei #TransformTalks, he explains that even the smartest banking agents will fail if customers don't trust them.

Explore more to understand why trust is the real currency in the AI era: https://bit.ly/44fPU4s #ThisIsHuawei #HiFS2026 #AgenticBanking
title: Banks Need AI-Native Foundations, but Trust Still Matters

author: Huawei
description:
Chinese enterprises are redefining how China connects with the world.
 
As businesses expand beyond borders and deepen their local presence, innovation is unlocking new opportunities across global markets. With global infrastructure, AI-powered capabilities, and localized support, Huawei Cloud helps enterprises accelerate their globalization journey.
 
Join industry leaders from iFLYTEK, iQIYI, Kingsoft Office, and AiMT as they share real-world experiences, challenges, and insights on expanding internationally and capturing new growth opportunities worldwide.
 
#Huawei #HuaweiCloud
title: Going Global, Growing Local with Huawei Cloud
